intro.background: 教玩具生产周期：实木家具30-45天，户外非标设备60-90天。旺季延长50%。交期沟通要具体：下单→定金到账→采购材料→生产→质检→包装→发货。每周更新进度，让客户安心。
intro.desc: 掌握生产排期和交期沟通的英语表达。

oneLiner.en: In custom manufacturing, the lead time is a promise — weekly updates prove you are keeping it.
oneLiner.cn: 定制生产中，交期是承诺——每周更新证明你在兑现。

vocab.ex: Lead time is 45 days for furniture.
The production schedule starts after deposit.
vocab.exCn: 生产排期定金到账后开始。

vocab.ex: We send weekly updates to clients.
vocab.exCn: 我们每周给客户发更新。

vocab.ex: ETA to Ningbo port is October 20th.

mistakes.right: Production takes 45 days after deposit. We will ship on October 20th.
mistakes.cn: 错误：说很快好。要给具体日期。

advanced.en: Our standard lead time is 45 days for furniture and 60-90 days for custom outdoor equipment, starting from deposit receipt. We provide weekly photo updates and ETA tracking.
advanced.cn: 我们标准交期：家具45天，户外非标60-90天，从定金到账起算。每周发照片更新和ETA追踪。

advanced.en: If any delay occurs, we will notify you immediately with the new ETA and reason — transparency is our policy.
advanced.cn: 如有延误，我们会立即通知您新的ETA和原因——透明是我们的原则。

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: How is production going? We need the goods before December 1st.
lines.cn: 生产怎么样了？我们12月1日前需要货。

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Good news — production is on schedule. We are currently in the assembly stage. Expected completion is November 10th, and ETA to your port is November 25th.
lines.cn: 好消息——生产按计划进行。目前在组装阶段。预计11月10日完工，11月25日到您港口。

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: That is cutting it close. Can you expedite?

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: We will do our best to finish by November 5th. I will send photos this weekend. If everything goes well, we can ship 3 days earlier.
lines.cn: 我们会尽量11月5日前完工。这周末我发照片给您。顺利的话可以提前3天发货。

fillBlank.q: ____ stands for Estimated Time of Arrival.

scenario.q: A client asks about production progress. How do you respond?
scenario.modelAnswer: Production is on schedule. We are currently in the assembly stage, expected completion is November 10th, ETA to your port is November 25th. We will send photo updates this weekend. If everything goes well, we can finish 3 days earlier.
scenario.cn: 生产按计划进行。目前在组装阶段，预计11月10日完工，11月25日到港。这周末发照片更新。顺利的话提前3天完工。

culture.title: 交期沟通的信任
culture.content: 教玩具客户最怕失联供应商。每周一固定发：生产照片+当前阶段+预计完成日+ETA。哪怕出问题，提前说比瞒到最后强100倍。

rounds.ai: We need the goods before December 1st.
